notes: Sequential workloads; no concurrent test or benchmark processes.
Default server: seed 4217, one room/view, run to completion. Default client: entry, hold D, 12 seconds after warmup.
Projection pairs alternate fa1e1b9/current with ten views, seed 4217, run to completion.
Crowd: seed 4217, fixed observer, ten actors total, traps disabled and large shields. AI actors may move after initial placement.
Server crowd series are per scheduler wake, including idle wakes. Divide sim.step mean by its calls to estimate mean cost per simulated tick over the same window.
Raw series retain at most 600 samples; timing is local, not production capacity or proof of a slowdown fix.
